summary.headline: Astrological Interrogations, §§11–30
summary.text: Continuation of a catalogue of astrological interrogations, covering rulers and kings, prosperity and misfortune, stellar speed, accusations, separations, conception, agriculture, wells, visitors, choices, events, rumors of death, travel, journeys, and clothing, with cross-references to Codex 7 and Hephaestus.
